page.overview:
Who is Mick Callahan?

Mick Callahan is the deuteragonist of The New Kid, the third story in Fazbear Frights 3: 1:35AM. He's Devon's best and only friend who's childish behavior make him an outcast at school.

Mick has a round face with round wire-rimmed glasses, reddish-blond hair with bangs, a freckled forehead and face, a small mouth, and large brown eyes. He’s somewhat chubby and almost as tall as Devon. Mick wears a superhero watch, high-waisted corduroy pants, and button-down short-sleeve shirts.

Mick likes doing whatever makes him happy, which makes him nerdy and childish. He loves eating and using out-of-date or even made up slang. Mick is obsessed with superheroes and sci-fi, constantly talking about those two subjects. He also likes statistics, enjoying baseball just for the stats. Mick has some undiagnosed learning disorders and tends to have attention issues, constantly caught daydreaming and staring out the school windows. Deep down, Mick does care about fitting in at school and is hurt by how much he and Devon are ignored, but is more fearful of rejection and still wants to stay in his fantasy world. He also doesn’t let things bother him so he isn’t miserable all the time. Despite his occasional sharp moments, Mick is rather innocent and naïve, as he is very trusting of his family and friends.
